description: Lists the people at an event the person has joined whose stated intent fits theirs. Needs a personal connector token; the event is `eventId` or the current one. Each row carries a first name, intent, who they are looking for, their booth if a vendor, `fit` and `why`. No row carries a phone number, email address, surname, account id or photo. Only people who chose to be findable are listed, at most 20, ordered best fit first by what each person wrote on their badge; two buyers whose lines agree are matches for each other. `fit` is one of three words: "strong" (most of what the caller declared is echoed on the other side), "good" (a real overlap) or "some" (a reason to be on the list and no more). `why` is one sentence written by the server naming the shared words, or the topic both wrote about. The reply carries no score, percentage, rating or rank. With no intent set the reply has `needsIntent` and no rows. An empty reply carries `emptyReason` and a plain `message` (none_findable, none_present, event_not_live or no_text_match).

eventId.description: Optional. An event the person has joined. When absent, the event the person is currently in.

name: event_find_matches
